title: SRD: Nimble Escape belongs to the goblin's stat block; engine: refusing it for a creature without the trait cites no page or rule

history.summary: nimble_escape now refuses a creature without the trait with page=290, rule=MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior#24 (tagged SRD[...#24]). It also refuses any option other than Disengage or Hide, where before anything else silently became a Hide. Unit tests added. Unit suite, ticket test (--runxfail), ruff and dev-gate all pass.
